sentences.text:
Order 
14.08.2024 Petitioner through the medium of this petition seeks direction to the respondents for payment of compensation of their land measuring 01 kanal and 06 Marlas falling under survey No.
135 situated at Village Naina Gund Baba Khalil, Tehsil Bijbehara, District Anantnag used by the respondents for the construction of the Government High School Naina Gund Baba Khalil,
Bijbehara, Anantnag, without acquiring the same in terms of Land Acquisition Act.
Issue notice to the respondents in the main petition as well as in CM returnable within a period of four weeks.

(M.A.CHOWDHARY) JUDGE SRINAGAR 14.08.2024 "S. Nuzhat"
